items.title: 14.15 Fiza se mutalliq qawaneen aur zawabit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.15 heading, printed page 318.

blocks.text: Pakistan mein hawa ki aaloodgi qawaneen aur zawabit (14.15.1) aur ikhraj ghatane ke khaas iqdamat (14.15.2) se qaboo mein rakhi jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Hawa ki aaloodgi par qaboo pane ke liye qawaneen kyun chahiye jab use ghatane ki technologies pehle se maujood hain?
blocks.explanation: Converters, filters aur scrubbers lagane par paisa lagta hai jo aaloodgi phailane wale tab tak kharch nahi karte jab tak ikhraj ke mayar nafiz na hon; qawaneen mayar tay karte hain, unhen lazmi banate hain aur saza ki ijazat dete hain, taake technologies asal mein istemal hon.

items: Hawa ki aaloodgi qawaneen aur zawabit aur khaas control iqdamat se qaboo mein rakhi jati hai.
